//: The ts-drizzle-sqlite pack (ADR 2026-055): SQLite persistence through Drizzle with versioned SQL migrations. Depends only on ts, so it composes with or without ts-service; @types/node is pinned here as well as in ts-service because the seeded database client uses Node's file APIs and a ts + ts-drizzle-sqlite project has no other source for it (identical pins merge). drizzle.config.ts is generated project config (projectConfigFiles, projectConfigNames): the migration check and generator execute it, so no role may write it and it is drift-checked. The migration check ships as scripts/check-db.ts and is folded into the project's `check`, so the generated manifest is already the delivered one. migrations/ sits outside src/ so no role's write zone reaches it: only the generate_artifacts gate writes it. projectIgnoreRules keep local database files out of Git; the SQL history stays in.
